parsed_json.reasoning_summary: The function returns the maximum of two subsequences without considering the case where they are equal. This leads to incorrect results. The fix is to return the concatenation of the common prefix and the recursive call when the first characters are equal.

modifications.code: return a[0] + longest_common_subsequence(a[1:], b[1:]) if a[0] == b[0] else max(longest_common_subsequence(a, b[1:]), longest_common_subsequence(a[1:], b), key=len)
